nodes.label: Python Runtime Plan (Pyodide/JupyterLite)
nodes.rationale: Python runtime is planned via Pyodide/JupyterLite. This demo ships the JS sandbox first to keep the desktop package light.

nodes.label: Markdown as Base File Format
nodes.rationale: All enhanced blocks stored as plain ``` code blocks in Markdown — no proprietary format, no vendor lock-in. Any Markdown editor can open the file.

nodes.label: Inline Enhancement (Source=Document, Preview=App)
nodes.rationale: Enhanced blocks render in-place within the document body, not in separate panels. Like Markdown images — write-time config becomes view-time content.

nodes.label: Sandbox Isolation for Code and Data
nodes.rationale: Code execution and data access happen in isolated Web Worker / iframe, ensuring host page security. Local files never leave the machine.
nodes.norm_label: sandbox isolation for code and data

nodes.label: File-Over-App Design Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Documents remain plain .md files — portable, migratable, extensible. The application serves the file, not the other way around.
